svg.title: A two by two grid. A checklist query that matches the violation passes on a healthy board and fails on a bad one, which is correct. A query phrased the natural way, matching the healthy case, does the reverse: it fails on a healthy board and passes on a bad one. A query binding reports what it matches, and a finding means the item failed, so the polarity has to be the violation.
svg.text: which is what a binding needs
the query matches the healthy case
phrased the natural way, and inverted
a query binding reports what it MATCHES, and a finding means the item failed
so an inverted item is quiet: on a healthy board it reads as a finding nobody got round to
